combat_structure.description: Combat is divided into rounds and turns.

round.description: During a round, every participant (player and NPC alike) acts once in their own turn. The round ends when everyone has taken their turn.

turn.description: A single character's opportunity to act within a round.

initiative.description: At the start of combat, every participant rolls a Simple (–) check.

skills.Cool: Used when the character anticipated the confrontation.
skills.Vigilance: Used when the character was caught by surprise.

slot_assignment.ordering: Number of successes (#) determines initiative order. Advantages (O) break ties.
slot_assignment.slot_control: Slots belong to a side, not a specific character. When a player-side slot opens, the players decide who acts in it.

turn_actions.description: A character may perform three categories of activity during their turn.

incidentals.description: Minor actions that take almost no time.
incidentals.limit: Multiple allowed per turn at GM discretion.

maneuvers.description: Take time but require no check.

actions.description: The primary activity of a turn; usually involves a dice roll.

trade_action_for_maneuver.description: A character may sacrifice their action to gain one additional maneuver.

combat_check.description: An attack is a specialized skill check consisting of the following steps.

steps.name: Declare target and weapon
steps.description: Choose the target and the weapon to be used.

steps.name: Build dice pool
steps.description: Base pool comes from the character's characteristic and skill rating. Difficulty (purple dice) is set by range band and other circumstances.

steps.name: Resolve successes and damage
steps.description: If net successes (#) remain, the attack hits.

steps.name: Spend Advantages (O) and Triumphs ($)
steps.description: Used to inflict Critical Injuries or activate special weapon qualities.

steps.name: Resolve Threats (®) and Despairs (^)
steps.description: The GM may impose negative effects.

range_bands.description: The game uses five range categories instead of metric distances.

difficulty.ranged: Harder or impossible depending on weapon

soak.description: Reduces incoming damage before it affects wounds.
soak.effect: Subtract soak from incoming damage; remainder reduces wounds.

wound_threshold.description: Maximum wounds a character can sustain.
wound_threshold.exceed_effect: Character is incapacitated and immediately suffers one Critical Injury.

strain_threshold.description: Maximum strain a character can sustain.

critical_injuries.description: Rolled on a d100 table when triggered.

severity_escalation.description: Each existing Critical Injury adds +10 to the next critical roll, producing increasingly severe results.
